text: 天孚通信公告，公司拟使用自有资金以集中竞价方式回购公司股份，回购资金总额不低于人民币1亿元且不超过人民币1.5亿元，回购价格不超过人民币350元/股。回购股份将全部注销并相应减少公司注册资本；方案尚需提交股东会审议。
text_en: Tianfu Communication announced that the company plans to use its own funds to repurchase shares through centralized bidding, with a total repurchase amount of no less than RMB 100 million and no more than RMB 150 million, and a repurchase price of no more than RMB 350 per share. All repurchased shares will be cancelled and the company's registered capital will be reduced accordingly; the plan still needs to be submitted to the shareholders' meeting for review.
